text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position and repeated defense against driverless cars","quality":"stance development","description":"The essay states a position early and keeps building reasons for it throughout the response."},{"evidence":"“Like it says in paragraph 9” and “The driver should not be responsible…”","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses a specific detail from the article to back up its argument instead of relying only on opinion."},{"evidence":"“If there was an accident, then the manufacturer should be blamed…”","quality":"reasoned explanation","description":"The essay more fully explains why its claims make sense, especially about liability and safety."},{"evidence":"three related paragraphs with a concluding restatement","quality":"organization","description":"The essay has a more developed structure with an introduction, body support, and a conclusion that circles back to the main claim."},{"evidence":"“People should be in control of their own cars…”","quality":"clarity of expression","description":"The essay communicates its ideas more directly and coherently, making the argument easier to follow."}]}
